clone_rule: Every required arm is a paired clone of the byte-identical assay-specific pre-treatment snapshot.
assignment_rule: Before execution, assign arm labels to clone slots by SHA256(domain || recipient_life_id || run_seed || arm_id), ascending hash then arm_id; seal the complete map.
seed_rule: Before execution, seal label-independent seeds keyed by recipient_life_id, assay_id, stage_id, and call_ordinal. Corresponding extant calls use the same seed. An absent call consumes no seed and never shifts later ordinals.

assays.estimand: paired observable dependence of action value on response identity and timing
paired total effects of DREAM_TO_SLEEP assignment inclusive of induced evidence dose, training, publication, inference, and resources

d1a_corpus.snapshot: All pre-boundary direct closed eligible ACQUIRE records; no DREAM nomination.
d1a_corpus.dedup: Group exact canonical tuple (subject_id,relation_id,object_id,public_record_bytes); choose lexicographically least eligible record_id.
d1a_corpus.capacity: Apply K_root once after deduplication; first K_root rows survive.
d1a_corpus.zero: VALID_EMPTY and a zero-dose observed arm.

matched_binding_shuffle.construction_time: Before PROBE assignment and without action outcomes or target fields.
matched_binding_shuffle.eligible_pair: Destination and donor are different authentic rows; object_id and record_id bindings differ; substitute donor object/record into destination subject/relation response; substituted target has the same locked-token count and byte-length class as destination authentic target.
matched_binding_shuffle.matching: Build the finite bipartite graph. Order destination vertices by canonical authentic row order. Order candidate donor edges by SHA256('PPC5R3_BINDING' || recipient_life_id || sealed_seed || destination_row_hash || donor_row_hash), then donor_row_hash. Depth-first enumerate assignments in destination order and select the first perfect derangement.
invariants: different authentic and shuffled corpus hashes
matched_binding_shuffle.failure: Any missing perfect derangement or failed invariant is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL before assignment.
matched_binding_shuffle.boundary: Control rows use contract ppc5.control_sleep_row.v3 and may enter only MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED_READER training. They never enter the public ledger or positive-evidence audit.

wrong_life.population: Recipient-disjoint sealed donor roster constructed before any model or training call.
wrong_life.matching: Order compatible donor edges by SHA256('PPC5R3_DONOR' || run_seed || recipient_life_id || donor_life_id), then donor_life_id; depth-first enumerate recipients in recipient_life_id order and select the first perfect one-to-one matching.
wrong_life.construction_failure: No perfect compatible matching is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL before assignment.
wrong_life.runtime_failure: Assigned donor adapter missing is MISSING with no replacement; hash/shape mismatch is RUN_INVALID.
wrong_life.cross_life_payload: Only typed adapter bytes and compatibility manifest; all donor ledger, IDs, roots, answers, prompts, and workspace bytes are forbidden.

overlap_scope.rule: Publish and seal cross-role and cross-donor overlap counts before assignment; report presealed strata descriptively.
overlap_scope.claim_boundary: PPC5 tests supported selection, not novelty or semantic generalization. No overlap stratum can rescue or block the registered narrow claim. Any future novelty claim requires a separate zero-overlap design.
